metadata.title: Experimental Trajectory Dataset of Rotating Disk Particles in a Quasi-2D Chiral Active Fluid
metadata.description:
Comprehensive trajectory dataset from quasi-2D chiral active fluid experiments featuring chiral rotating disk particles driven by bottom air flow.

### Data Contents
- Particle positions (x, y) in mm/pixels and orientation angle (theta) in radians.
- Variations in particle count (N), packing fraction (phi), and frame rate (FPS).
- Each experiment contains a matching trajectory CSV file and a metadata JSON file.

### Hardware & Code
Code for tracking and data analysis is available on GitHub (see Related Identifiers).
metadata.notes: This deposit contains multiple experiments. Each experiment has a CSV trajectory file and a metadata JSON file, both identified by a unique experiment ID in the filename.
